suspects.motive: Years of service with little recognition.
suspects.opportunity: Access to every room in the manor.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was supervising staff in the courtyard.

suspects.motive: A secret debt to a moneylender.
suspects.opportunity: Cleaning duty near the study that evening.
suspects.alibi: Says she was in the kitchen polishing silver.

suspects.motive: Dismissal threatened after a ruined banquet.
suspects.opportunity: The kitchen adjoins the dining room.
suspects.alibi: Insists the roast was in the oven all night.

suspects.motive: An inheritance dispute with the victim.
suspects.opportunity: Private meeting in the library before dinner.
suspects.alibi: Retired early to the study, or so he says.

suspects.motive: Protecting the family name from scandal.
suspects.opportunity: Last seen arguing in the garden.
suspects.alibi: Reading alone by the fountain, she claims.

roomNarratives.summary: The grand hall feels colder than it should. Something happened here recently.
Books are out of place, as if someone searched in haste.
The table is set, but one chair was pushed back violently.

generatedClues.name: Torn Page
generatedClues.description: A torn page from a ledger, the ink still fresh.

generatedClues.name: Stained Apron
generatedClues.description: A kitchen apron with a faint rust-coloured stain.

generatedClues.name: Silver Key
generatedClues.description: A small key that does not match any obvious lock in the hall.

generatedClues.name: Wilting Rose
generatedClues.description: A rose dropped near the fountain, petals crushed underfoot.

generatedClues.name: Charred Note
generatedClues.description: Most of a note burned away; only a time remains legible: eleven.

clueAssignments.hint: Pages are scattered across the table. One sheet was torn out deliberately.
A stained apron hangs over the back of a chair.
Something glints between the stone steps.
Petals float in the fountain basin.
Ashes in the grate still smell of burnt paper.

npcDialogOverrides.default: Good evening. I trust you will be discreet.

conditions.dialog: That key? It is not mine. I have not seen it before tonight.

npcDialogOverrides.default: I've finished in the kitchen, if that is what you need.

conditions.dialog: The library? I dusted there earlier. I did not touch the ledger.

npcDialogOverrides.default: The roast was perfect. I have nothing to hide.

conditions.dialog: That apron is mine, but the stain— that's sauce, surely.

npcDialogOverrides.default: I retired early. These old bones need rest.

conditions.dialog: The ledger? Absurd. I was nowhere near the library after dinner.

npcDialogOverrides.default: The garden air helps me think. Do not disturb me long.

conditions.dialog: That rose was a gift. I left it by the fountain hours ago.
